mapper.select: SELECT * FROM account_group WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account WHERE account_group_id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT FROM account a INNER JOIN account_state s ON s.account_id=a.id AND s.tenant_id=a.tenant_id WHERE a.account_group_id=#{groupId} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.account_state=2 AND s.login_state=1 AND (s.risk_status IS NULL OR s.risk_status=1) AND s.mute_status IS NULL AND UPPER(a.protocol_id) IN ('WEB','ANDROID') AND TRIM(a.protocol_account_id)<>'' AND TRIM(a.ws_phone)<>'' ORDER BY a.id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM account a INNER JOIN account_state s ON s.account_id=a.id AND s.tenant_id=a.tenant_id WHERE a.id=#{id} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id FROM account WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM account_mutual_contact_task WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM account_mutual_contact_task WHERE created_by=#{userId} AND request_id=#{requestId}
SELECT * FROM account_mutual_contact_task WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{q.pageSize} OFFSET #{q.offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.status=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS pending, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.status=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS submitted, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.status=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS success, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.status=4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS failed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.status=5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS `unknown`, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.status=6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS canceled, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.actor_id<i.target_id AND i.status=3 AND r.status=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS mutual_pairs, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.actor_id<i.target_id AND ((i.status=3 AND r.status<>3) OR (i.status<>3 AND r.status=3)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS one_way_pairs FROM account_mutual_contact_item i LEFT JOIN account_mutual_contact_item r ON r.task_id=i.task_id AND r.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND r.actor_id=i.target_id AND r.target_id=i.actor_id WHERE i.task_id=#{taskId}
SELECT * FROM account_mutual_contact_item WHERE ORDER BY id LIMIT #{q.pageSize} OFFSET #{q.offset}
SELECT * FROM account_mutual_contact_item WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND actor_id=#{actorId} AND status=1 ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account_mutual_contact_item WHERE actor_id=#{actorId} AND (status IN (2,5) OR next_execute_at>#{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE account_mutual_contact_task SET status=#{status},updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE account_mutual_contact_item SET status=6,reason_code='TASK_STOPPED',updated_at=#{now} WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND status=1
UPDATE account_mutual_contact_item SET status=1,reason_code=NULL,updated_at=#{now} WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND status=4 AND retryable=1
UPDATE account_mutual_contact_item SET status=5,reason_code='RESULT_TIMEOUT',updated_at=#{now} WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND status=2 AND submitted_at<=#{deadline}
mapper.select: SELECT i.tenant_id,i.task_id,i.actor_id FROM account_mutual_contact_item i INNER JOIN account_mutual_contact_task t ON t.id=i.task_id AND t.tenant_id=i.tenant_id WHERE t.status IN (1,4) AND i.status=1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM account_mutual_contact_item b WHERE b.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND b.actor_id=i.actor_id AND (b.status IN (2,5) OR b.next_execute_at>#{now})) GROUP BY i.tenant_id,i.task_id,i.actor_id ORDER BY MIN(i.updated_at),MIN(i.id) LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT tenant_id,task_id,MIN(actor_id) AS actor_id FROM account_mutual_contact_item WHERE status=2 AND submitted_at<=#{deadline} GROUP BY tenant_id,task_id ORDER BY MIN(submitted_at) LIMIT #{limit}
